name: Blasphemy
summary: Daze, weaken, paralyze, or kill nonevil creatures according to their Hit Dice.
description:
A nonevil creature in the spread is affected only if its Hit Dice do not exceed your caster level. Apply each threshold it qualifies for cumulatively. Make one Will save and apply the result to each effect.

At your caster level or lower, the target is dazed for one round unless it saves. At one Hit Die below or lower, it also loses 2d6 Strength for 2d4 rounds, halved on a save. At five Hit Dice below or lower, it is paralyzed for 1d10 minutes, shortened to one round on a save.

At 10 or more Hit Dice below your caster level, a living target dies and an undead target is destroyed. On a successful save it instead takes 3d6 damage plus 1 per caster level (maximum +25). If cast on your home plane, Blasphemy also banishes nonevil extraplanar creatures on a failed Will save made at −4. They cannot return for 24 hours. This banishment applies even to creatures that cannot hear the spell.
area: nonevil creatures in a 40-ft.-radius spread centered on you
